title: The clubhouse pickup
body: The clubhouse key is signed out for a pickup, while a grounds note says the water cart was already sent away. The passenger line is blank.
rival_reading: A field crew could take the cart for a work visit; the missing passenger line does not show who was expected.
gloss: A pickup is scheduled after its water cart has left.

title: The second fairway note
body: A grounds notebook marks a test strip along the course edge; a handwritten note asks players to keep their shoes out of the drainage ditch.
rival_reading: A response team could mark off a ditch during a cleanup; the note does not identify what was applied to the strip.
gloss: A test strip and a shoe warning share the course grounds log.
